title: The Dares newest release, “Cupid (redux)” is a fierce, reimagined shot straight to the heart
htmlContent:
The Dares latest song, Cupid (redux), is a fantastic example of how a band can reinvent themselves. This new version of their older track brings a fresh, energetic vibe that stands out with its powerful sound. While the original version of Cupid had a steady feel, this new take hits hard with an exciting edge that feels urgent and alive.

Everything is sharper, from the guitar riffs to the driving rhythm and the stronger vocals, showing how The Dares have grown and evolved as a band. The song was recorded in a conference room at an office in Newport Beach, giving it an authentic, spontaneous feel.

https://open.spotify.com/track/029bxHuASDSOo6rXDmflsS?si=eignIk6yTZeIN0bIaBl4HQ

Plus, they finished tracking, mixing, and mastering the song in less than a month, adding to the excitement. The Dares are showcasing their journey and growth. Fans of their earlier music will recognize the connection to their roots, while new listeners will be drawn in by the raw power of a band.
